description: Send civil, excavation and underground utility tenders to Neil Smith Construction. Prime and subcontract bids across Metro Vancouver and the Fraser Valley.

hero.title: Have a tender?
hero.subtitle: We price civil, excavation, earthworks and underground utility tenders for owners, construction managers and general contractors. Email info@nscltd.ca or call 604-644-5884.

items.title: Excavation and earthworks
items.text: Bulk and detail excavation, shoring, hauling, grading and site preparation.

items.title: Underground utilities
items.text: Sanitary, storm and water mains and services, sewer separation, manholes and hydrants.

items.title: Site servicing
items.text: Complete site servicing for school additions, modular classrooms, housing and commercial development.

items.title: Roads and concrete
items.text: Road construction and restoration, curb and gutter, sidewalks and slabs.

items.title: Stormwater
items.text: Detention tanks and flow control manholes.

items.title: Civil works packages
items.text: Civil scope for seismic upgrades, public facilities and campus buildings.

items.title: Send the documents
items.text: Email drawings, specifications, the tender form and any geotechnical reports to info@nscltd.ca, with the closing date in the subject line.

items.title: We review the package
items.text: Our estimating division prices the work and comes back to you with any questions. We respond within one business day.

items.title: Send addenda
items.text: Send addenda to the same address so the estimate stays current to closing.

items.title: Prequalification
items.text: We provide our safety program documentation, COR certificate and prequalification package on request.

blocks.title: We bid both ways.
blocks.body:
We bid as prime contractor on municipal and private civil work, and as the civil subcontractor to construction managers and general contractors on school, housing and public facility projects.

Clients and partners include the City of Vancouver, the City of Surrey, the University Endowment Lands, school districts in Surrey, Delta, Richmond, New Westminster and Burnaby, Unitech Construction Management, Pro-Can Construction Group, Scott Special Projects, Kinetic Construction, Keller Construction and SmartCentres. See [all projects](projects/index.html).

items.q: Do you accept tenders from general contractors and construction managers?
items.a: Yes. Much of our school, housing and public facility work is as the civil subcontractor to construction managers and general contractors.

items.q: What area do you bid in?
items.a: Metro Vancouver and the Fraser Valley, from the University Endowment Lands to Chilliwack. Our head office is in Richmond and our yard is in Langley.
Our estimating team responds within one business day of receiving a tender package or bid request.

items.q: Can you send a prequalification package?
items.a: Yes. We provide our safety program documentation, COR certificate and prequalification package on request. Email info@nscltd.ca.

blocks.title: Send your tender.
blocks.text: Email drawings and tender documents to info@nscltd.ca or call 604-644-5884.
